sentence: You will complete your tenth year of travelling next month.
synonym: finish your ten years of travel
synonymNote: 两者都表示旅行满十年，意思相同。

distractors.word: start your tenth year of travelling
distractors.note: start表示开始，而非完成，意思相反。

distractors.word: enjoy your tenth year of travelling
distractors.note: enjoy表示享受，不表示完成某年。

distractors.word: plan your tenth year of travelling
distractors.note: plan表示计划，不表示完成旅行年份。
